uv_export_adapter.rationale: Original XAF V coordinates are already authored in the same semantic top-to-bottom direction as glTF. Trimesh uses the opposite internal texture convention, so the adapter pre-flips V once before export so raw GLB TEXCOORD_0 equals source XAF UV exactly.

source_authored_state_variants.rationale: BAPMSG is the nested hidden back face of tapestry2. Its source UV reverses world Y; a 180-degree horizontal-axis reveal flips both facing and vertical orientation.
